intro: Final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science (AI & Data Science) and Data Analyst Intern at Krios Info Solutions. I build grounded LLM applications, agentic RAG systems and data products that are measured, tested and honest about their limits.

about: I'm a Computer Science (AI & Data Science) student at Pimpri Chinchwad University, Pune, graduating in 2027. I currently work as a Data Analyst Intern at Krios Info Solutions, where I build Tableau and Power BI dashboards and the Python and SQL pipelines behind them.

Outside work I build end-to-end projects: agentic AI with LangGraph, hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense + reranking) with citation checking, FastAPI backends on PostgreSQL / Supabase, and full-stack apps deployed to the cloud. I care about measuring what I build: benchmarks, automated tests, CI and honest notes on limitations.
I'm looking for opportunities in applied AI, data science and data analytics, where I can work on real problems and keep learning from experienced teams.

contact.message: Whether it's an internship, a full-time role or a project collaboration, I'd love to hear from you. The quickest way to reach me is email or LinkedIn.
